hud.ready.title: Ready
hud.ready.hint: Hold Y to start recording, or press Menu to open the panel.
hud.intro.title: Notes
hud.intro.tips:
• Keep your hands, body and your reflection out of the shots
• Move slowly and steadily, and pause briefly for each photo
• Photograph each spot from several angles and heights
• Hold Y for 3 seconds to go to the next step
hud.step1.title: Step 1 - Scan the room
hud.step1.hint: Look around slowly until the balls cover the walls, floor and ceiling.
hud.step1.tips:
• Stay about a metre away from surfaces
• Make sure everything is covered, including corners and around furniture
hud.step2.title: Step 2 - Take photos
hud.step2.hint: The balls change colour as you photograph them. You can move on whenever you are happy; they don't all need to turn green.
hud.step2.tips:
• Trigger: one photo · Hold the grip: continuous
• The lit side of a ball is where it has been photographed from
• Orange means not enough, green means enough, blue means well covered with a close-up
hud.step3.title: Step 3 - Free capture
hud.step3.hint: Fill in spots you missed, or get close to small objects and details. Skip this step if you don't need it.
hud.step3.tips:
• Trigger: one photo · Hold the grip: continuous
• Nearby surfaces you have photographed are covered by a blue point cloud
hud.timed.title: Timed recording
hud.timed.tips: • Hold Y for 3 seconds to finish
